---
title: "Advice for Recommendations"
pagetitle: "Advice for Recommendations — Ryan T. Moore"
toc: false
---

If you would like me to write you a letter of recommendation:

- Read Gary King's [considerations and advice](https://gking.harvard.edu/recs)
- Send me a _single_ PDF with the materials Gary King describes
- Give me as much advance notice before the recommendation due date as possible
